limitations: Photograph-informed fitting to inherited station footprint and storey heights; not a measured reconstruction.
Recess setback, cornice profiles and carving dimensions are model estimates.
Copper hue represents a plausible finish under the reference lighting; not a survey of present-day patina.
Completion aerial photography predates the present plaza, which is not rebuilt from it.
Catenary audit classifications, all rolling stock and the V15 underground cutaway remain unchanged.
